**Publish gate report**

**Going out:** landing hero copy for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On the policy list. The wording matches and the source ("on our website") is stated. |
| Organic | On the policy list (certified organic by the Soil Association). |
| Plastic-free bags | On the policy list (tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable). |
| Packed by hand in Bristol | On the policy list for tins ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). |

**Regulated claims:** The environmental claims ("organic", "plastic-free") are specific and backed by the policy, not broad "eco" or "green" wording. There is no health, money, price or urgency language.

**House style:** There are no AI tells, no stock openers and no slogan closers. It is plain and specific. The score is above 80, so I made no rewrite.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own page, with no sponsorship, affiliate links, gifted products or AI-generated content. No label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing.

**Needs a decision (optional):** The policy covers tins being hand-packed. The sentence can be read as saying the bags are hand-packed too. If the bags aren't packed by hand in Bristol, say "every tin packed by hand in Bristol" instead. If they are, add that to the policy. I haven't blocked on this.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name an approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on this exact text before it goes live. I haven't recorded any approval.
